externalPriceCents.description: External price in integer cents; null for a variant group.

memberPriceCents.description: Member (adherent) price in integer cents; null for a group.

hasVariants.description: True when this product has variants (sold via a panel).

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the product photo, or null when none.

stockQty.description: Current stock; null when policy is `untracked`.

externalPriceCents.description: External price in integer cents (D9). Required together with memberPriceCents for a sellable product; omit both to create a variant group (its variants carry the prices).

memberPriceCents.description: Member (adherent) price in integer cents. Required together with externalPriceCents.

initialStock.description: Initial stock (ignored when stock policy is `untracked`).

minSelect.description: Minimum choices the buyer must select.

maxSelect.description: Maximum choices the buyer may select (≥ 1, ≥ minSelect).

priceDeltaCents.description: Surcharge added to the line, in integer cents.

id.description: Grid id, or product id for item reorder.

externalPriceCents.description: External price for a leaf; null for a variant group.

variantCount.description: Number of variants; > 0 means the POS opens a panel.

productId.description: Top-level product id (the group, or a leaf product).

variantId.description: Chosen variant; required when the product has variants.

optionIds.description: Chosen option ids (from the product’s option groups).

memberId.description: Adherent to attribute the sale to (member pricing).

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated idempotency key (recommended for cash; a refused card order should be retried under a NEW key).

expiresAt.description: When a pending card order expires; null otherwise.

sumupTxId.description: SumUp transaction id from the device SDK (TransactionDone).

actor.description: actorUsername, or actorUserId as a fallback

totalCents.description: Gross revenue of completed sales, in cents

refundedCents.description: Total refunded over the period, in cents

isMember.description: True when the person has an active membership in the current year.

isCurrent.description: Mark this year current (unsets any other current year).

enabled.description: Whether this rail is usable at the POS.

apiKey.description: SumUp SDK key for the device; null for rails without one.

name.example: AEE — Association des Élèves de l’ENSSAT

firstAdminSub.description: Keycloak sub of the first admin (granted the admin tuple).
